method: For each target use median of the unmodified native grayscale rectangle y_center +/-8px across each x window. Visible THIN2 core uses its diagnostic peak y +/-3px. No segmentation threshold is fitted.
conclusion: All three target rectangles have ordinary-background-like grayscale and no resolved independent boundaries/endpoints in the expanded native views. CU2 broad prominence does not identify a bright conductor; darker rims and slowly varying background create an apparent bump.
limits: Grayscale similarity cannot prove material absence.
Different conductors can have different reflectance; visual edges, ends and context remain essential.
This is AI source triage only, not human truth, PDK DRC, exact photo registration or full physical coverage.
